@graph.name: Guardian Named Entity Recognition
@graph.description: Running NRE for Guardian on TDM Studio

@graph.name: Guardian NRE collation
@graph.description: Collating NRE results for Guardian

@graph.name: Concatenate article metadata
@graph.description: Concatenate the article metadata from each search into a single file.

@graph.name: Deduplicate article metadata
@graph.description: Ensure that the article metadata has only one row for each ProQuest article ID. This is required because some articles appear under the same ID in multiple databases.

@graph.name: Prepare entities for OpenRefine
@graph.description: Convert raw entity json files exported from TDM Studio to a CSV suitable for importing into OpenRefine.

@graph.name: OpenRefine cleaning
@graph.description: Do manual data cleaning on entity names with OpenRefine and export to CSV. The output CSV has both the original name and the cleaned name. The OpenRefine data cleaning operations are also exported as JSON.

@graph.name: Make entity maps
@graph.description: Takes the CSV files exported from OpenRefine, does some additional cleaning (folding entities like 'the united states' and 'united states', and writes the final entity map file which goes from raw, uncleaned entities to clean ones. Adds new clean ids as needed.

@graph.name: Filter articles
@graph.description: Merges the exported NRE parquet files, then remove articles which are in categories which shouldn't be counted, or which appear multiple times under different article ids. Writes out the filtered parquet file and metadata CSV, and a CSV file with the reasons for removal of each filtered article.
